content:
Kecksburg UFO crash involving Bell Shaped UFO is one of the most famous unsolved UFO cases in American history, often dubbed "Pennsylvania's Roswell." It occurred on December 9, 1965, in the small town of Kecksburg, Pennsylvania. 

#UFOTwitter #UFOs #UAPTwitter       

What Happened      

In the late afternoon/early evening, thousands of people across six U.S. states (including Michigan, Ohio, Pennsylvania, and others) and parts of Canada reported seeing a brilliant fireball streaking across the sky. It appeared to move in a controlled manner rather than a typical meteor trajectory, with some witnesses describing it changing direction or making a level descent.      

Reports included:      

-Sonic booms near Pittsburgh   
-Hot metal debris and grass fires in some areas   
-A "thump," vibrations, and blue smoke in Kecksburg      

Locals rushed to the woods near town, claiming an object had crashed there. Witnesses described finding a bronze- or acorn-shaped object (roughly 10-15 feet long, about the size of a small car or Volkswagen Beetle), with no visible wings or propulsion.     

Some said it had strange hieroglyphic-like markings etched around its base and appeared undamaged or smoldering.  Military personnel (including Army and Air Force) reportedly arrived quickly, cordoned off the area, and removed something on a flatbed truck. Witnesses claimed the object was taken away under secrecy, and the site was cleared overnight. The next day, officials said nothing was found.      

My own opinion on this incident       

I think this was a test of a bell-shaped anti-gravity flying machine, which was either seized by the Americans from the Germans after the Second World War, or was built by American scientists.
